description: Creates or replaces one sealed record in the caller's own repository in a space.

main.description: Creates or replaces one sealed record in the caller's own repository in a space.

blobs.description: Blobs the record refers to, so unreferenced ones can be deleted.

swapCid.description: Write only if the current record has this CID.

createOnly.description: Write only if no live record has this key.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The space isn't the caller's own, answered exactly as for a missing record.

errors.name: RecordTooLarge
errors.description: The request is larger than the largest sealed record can be.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: Storing the record would take the account past its storage quota. A write that stores no more than it replaces is never refused for this.

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: The account sent too many requests of this kind recently. Wait the seconds in the Retry-After header, then retry. Record writes, reads and blob uploads are counted separately.
